nodes.title: Creative Arts: Visual Arts
nodes.description: Visual Arts for Grade 9 with advanced artistic practice, independent project development, critical art history analysis, and preparation for FET Visual Arts.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: Advanced drawing techniques and observational study; Surrealism and symbolic art.

nodes.title: Drawing — Advanced Observation and Rendering
nodes.description: Advanced observational drawing: tonal values, shading techniques (hatching, cross-hatching, blending); still life in graphite, charcoal or mixed media; texture rendering; expressive drawing; developing a personal drawing style. Art history: Käthe Kollwitz — expressive drawing; South African draughtsmen. Practical task: complex still life or expressive observational drawing.

nodes.title: Painting — Surrealism and Symbolism
nodes.description: Surrealism: dream imagery, juxtaposition, unexpected combinations; symbolic art and personal symbolism; narrative painting; creating layered meaning in imagery. Art history: Salvador Dalí, René Magritte — Surrealism; Frida Kahlo — autobiographical symbolism. South African symbolic artists. Practical task: symbolic or surrealist painting expressing personal narrative.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Printmaking — etching and digital prints; Post-Apartheid South African art.

nodes.title: Printmaking — Advanced Techniques
nodes.description: Advanced printmaking: dry-point etching on plastic or aluminium foil; intaglio principles; multi-colour reduction linocut; developing a series of prints with a unified theme; editioning and signing prints. South African printmakers: William Kentridge — charcoal drawings and animation; Bonnie Ntshalintshali. Practical task: small editional print series on a social or personal theme.

nodes.title: Post-Apartheid South African Art and Identity
nodes.description: Post-1994 South African art: themes of identity, memory, reconciliation, transformation; land and place in art; gender and the body; political and social commentary through art; museums and public art in South Africa. Artists: Zanele Muholi, Marlene Dumas, Kendell Geers. Practical task: artwork responding to a South African social issue of the learner's choice.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Independent project development; installation, performance and video art.

nodes.title: Independent Creative Project — Research and Development
nodes.description: Self-directed creative project: choosing a theme or concept; research and inspiration gathering; visual diary / sketchbook development; creating preparatory studies and experiments; working across media; iterative creative process. Formal Assessment: project process portfolio (research, development, studies). Practical task: in-progress studio work and process documentation.

nodes.title: Installation, Performance and New Media Art
nodes.description: Contemporary art forms: installation art, performance art, video art, new media; art that uses space and the viewer's body; interactive art; art and technology. South African new media artists: Minnette Vári, Candice Breitz. Critical analysis of contemporary artworks — intent, materials, audience response. Optional: small-scale installation or video art piece.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Completing independent project; portfolio exhibition; art careers and pathways.

nodes.title: Independent Project — Final Artwork and Presentation
nodes.description: Completing final artwork for independent project; refining and finishing; mounting and presentation; writing an artist statement; presenting work to peers and audience; giving and receiving constructive critique. Formal Assessment: final artwork with portfolio and artist statement.

nodes.title: Art Careers and Pathways into FET
nodes.description: Careers in the visual arts and creative industries: fine art, graphic design, architecture, fashion, film, animation, art education; tertiary study options; building a portfolio for further study; reflecting on personal artistic development through the Senior Phase; introduction to Visual Arts in FET.
